demo.code:
You: What Pantheon vaults can I stake in?
Agent: (lists live Base and Robinhood Chain vaults from the Pantheon registry)
You: Stake 100,000 WOLF
Agent: (checks the vault address against the one pinned in the skill, relays the mandatory lock/fee disclosure, waits for your explicit yes, then exact-amount approve + stake — never an unlimited approval)

setup: Ask: What Pantheon vaults can I stake in?
